# Skylight Travel UAE

> Skylight Travel is Sharjah's premier travel agency offering custom holiday packages, international visa processing, flight bookings, and Umrah travel for UAE residents and expats. Based in Al Sajaa, Sharjah, UAE. Over 5,000+ UAE families served with a 99.4% visa approval rate.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **Why choose Skylight Travel in Sharjah?** We provide transparent pricing with zero hidden fees, personalized 1-on-1 WhatsApp support, and high-precision visa file preparation for VFS Global and embassies.
- **Can UAE residents travel visa-free anywhere?** Yes, UAE residents with valid residency enjoy visa-free entry or visa-on-arrival to Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Montenegro, and Serbia.
